# KaTeX browser assets

Vendored from the official npm package katex@0.16.22 (https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.16.22.tgz).
Files copied unmodified from dist: katex.min.js, katex.min.css, contrib/auto-render.min.js and fonts/.
The upstream MIT license is included in LICENSE. These assets serve slide math locally, without a runtime CDN dependency.
